conflicts.description: The holds check bans every write to tasks during converge, with no exception for the 'tasks_appended' outcome, but the appended, convergence-phase and convergence-lines rules require new tasks to be appended to tasks.md whenever gaps are found.
converge_2 bans every write to tasks with no exception for the 'tasks_appended' outcome, yet its appended rule requires tasks to be appended to tasks.md whenever the round-2 report finds gaps.

implement must tick every task and converge may not write to tasks, so no unticked tasks can be left when implement_2 starts, but implement_2's ticked rule (open_at_start: true) requires unticked tasks at that point.
